blurb: The kitchen is on fire and tickets won't stop! Dodge grease fires, mix the perfect portions, and power up your chef to survive the dinner rush.
title: Dinner Rush: Scale & Serve
scenes: Title with Play, How to Play, About Info
Guided Build tutorial: one scaled pan passes, one conversion dash
Rush Arena waves 1-5: escalating tickets and hazards with drafts every 30s
Elite Health Inspector mid-check and VIP Boss Rush finale
Win banquet and Fail kitchen-closed screens with Elegance score and retry
pillars: Every draft is a recipe decision, not a quiz gate
subject: Kitchen Math
core_loop: Dodge grease fires, spills, falling pans while auto-sprayer fires
Collect tips XP from served bites, fill level bar
Draft 1-of-3 pans/gadgets by scaling or converting correctly to build power
Route to expiring tickets to serve full tables, extinguish hazards
Survive 8 minutes then beat VIP boss rush for Elegance score
mechanics: Move with WASD/drag, one input; attacks auto-fire when loaded with correct portion
Scale drafts: show servings-listed, servings-wanted, one ingredient (e.g. 3/4 cup for 8, need 4 = pick 3/8; 2/3 cup for 6, need 12 = pick 1 1/3 cups); 3 pan options, rarity scales with speed+accuracy
Conversion dashes: gates labeled tsp/tbsp/mL (e.g. 2 tbsp = 6 tsp, 1 cup = 16 tbsp = 48 tsp = 237 mL); correct gate boosts, wrong slows
Tickets have 3-4 seats with patience bars; only full served table clears; expired ticket spawns spill hazard
Wounds: wrong draft adds Burnt Pan that clogs next draft until discarded by correct conversion streak
Mentor sous-chef demos first scaling with worked fade, then removes scaffolds
Par Elegance score: fewer drafts, faster serves, zero burns
objective: Scale any recipe to any party size with fraction multiplication and convert cups, tbsp, tsp, and mL fluently while serving full tables before patience runs out.
assessment: evidence-centered-tasks: pan draft only succeeds if scale factor and fraction work correct, trace logged
retrieve-practice: spaced conversion gates under mild time pressure, first-try accuracy and latency trend
formative-checkpoints: 3-ticket gate before boss, wrong triggers retry quest with targeted hint
worked-examples-fading: mentor demo then faded steps, hint requests per level tracked

Chubby cheerful chef in white hat and teal apron holding frying pan, front view
Cute but angry grease fire blob with orange flames
Cream order ticket with red clip showing burger icon
Golden frying pan with star sparkles for epic upgrade

visual_style.art_notes: Flat vector diner with thick outlines, big rounded UI, high-contrast cream panels with dark text. Chef and fires as simple silhouettes with expressive eyes. No photo texture, no tiny text. Warm light, juicy splashes, everything tweens and squashes, never hard cuts.
visual_style.reasoning: All-ages kitchen chaos needs instant readability at speed: bold flat shapes read while dodging, warm appetizing colors make math feel tasty not testy, and chunky icons support low readers.

genre_fit_note: Requested survivors arena fits well IF adapted to pass broccoli test: answers do not pause action to earn gear, answers ARE gear. Scaling: 3 pans show different scaled amounts, picking correct 3/8 cup for half of 3/4 cup loads flambe-shot that one-shots that ticket; wrong pan loads burnt pan that clogs next draft. Conversion: dash gates labeled 6 tsp vs 9 tsp for 2 tbsp, correct gate gives speed boost. Prioritization: movement itself is triage - which patience bar to save while kiting grease fires and spills. Better answers = better rarity, so studying builds the power fantasy.
